output_list.reason: The mint function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply + value <= TOKEN_LIMIT check is bypassed if value is crafted to be of a certain value.

The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[msg.sender] += value; totalSupply += value; Transfer(0x0, holder, value); is executed if value is crafted to be of a certain value.

The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value); allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = allowed[msg.sender][_spender].sub(_value); is executed if _value is crafted to be of a certain value.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = _value; is executed if _value is crafted to be of a certain value.

The increaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = allowed[msg.sender][_spender].add(_addedValue); is executed if _addedValue is crafted to be of a certain value.

The decreaseApproval function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The allowed[msg.sender][_spender] = oldValue.sub(_subtractedValue); is executed if _subtractedValue is crafted to be of a certain value.
